notes.title: Game Update (ver. 1.06)
notes.notes:
Update v1.06



Improvements:

Fixed a soft-lock that occurred after completing all 9 planets. Added an option to continue the game in an alternative, lifeless universe, while retaining all other progress. A reward is given for doing so.

Added a warp animation and a small congratulatory message upon continuing the game after populating the planets.

Fixes:

Slightly reworked magic stone icons in weapon descriptions: removed excess empty space after 3+ lines of stones, and the size of stones is adjusted to the size of the text lines

notes.title: Version v1.05
notes.notes:
A patch with fixes.

Improvements:
 Now all weapon stones are displayed directly in the weapon description
 Optimized wax output from 'Ecology' skill. Pieces are combined into larger ones, with values of 50 and 10, if possible


Fixes:
 Fixed a couple of issues with fractional rarity and max level in the descriptions of items with skulls and max level upgrades. The calculations were not changed, but the description was brought in line with reality
 The 'Energize' skill does not consume energy if it cannot improve anything
 Rings (and other non-weapon items) no longer store twinkles and cannot receive the 'flaming' prefix

notes.title: Version v1.04
notes.notes:
Version v1.04!

A patch with fixes.

Fixes:
  - The shards ritual button is no longer active in towns, since a free ritual is given there
  - Fixed damage in the description of the skill 'Blizzard': it dealt 2 times more than stated in the description. The skill was left as is, and the damage in the description was increased by 2 times
  - Fixed damage in the description of the skill 'Overload': previously it gave +25% damage per level in the description, but +50% in reality. Now in both cases it gives +50%
  - Fix for not counting the wax from falling wax particles in global stats and flame power calculations. The change affects the 'Ecology' skill, the bonus from bats from the 4th Dragon syllable and the bonus from 'eye' type creatures
  - Fixed the behavior of Wind Seal II with Wind King Mask. Previously, it continued to block soul acceleration, despite the fact that upgrading the seal from level 1 to level 2 removes the debuffs. Now the Wind King Mask accelerates souls as intended
  - Fixed a bug where during a transformation animation (Beetle, General, Wolf) you could start another transformation and ruin your shard walkthrough

notes.title: Version v1.03
notes.notes:
A small patch with fixes.

Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where 'Frost Soul' skill could be launched by active automation ignoring current mana (soul action, 'Cunning', etc), which could take mana values into the negatives.
 Golden Umbrella no longer gains temporary levels, as they never influenced its effect anyway.
 Fixed an issue with displaying the penalty from 'Rough Clicks' in the '+ crit %' part of the Dexterity bar, which ignored Rain syllables effect. Full information on crit is always available by pressing RMB on the damage icon on the top bar.
 Fixed a typo: 'assasin' -> 'assassin'.

notes.title: Version v1.02 - Another small update with a couple of fixes
notes.notes:
Version v1.02

Another small update with a couple of fixes.

Fixes:

 Fixed several bugs with masks while playing as a non-default character. In particular, it was possible to get another mask in the form of Beetle and General, if the player previously had a mask in the hidden skill tree.
 Similar fix now for three characters in Duplicity shards, when masks from hidden skill trees didn't count towards the limit of 2 masks.
  Added cloud saving hint to the main menu.
  Fixed a long-standing typo: 'dissasemble' -> 'disassemble'.

notes.title: Version v1.01 - A small update with a couple of fixes
notes.notes:
The game has been updated!
Version v1.01

A small update with a couple of fixes.

Fixes

 Fixed a bug with the General's 'Signal' skill. Its instakill part was sometimes missing small enemies.
 Fixed a bug where in Blood Shards disabling shard effects also turned off enemy regeneration.
 Fixed a visual bug in Beetle and General form that with Third Eye Mask and either skill at 0, the skill cost was showing as 10, even though it was actually 1, since this corresponds to the skills condition about availability if the player is already in the form from the skill. Now in both cases the cost is 1.

notes.title: Version 1.0 -- RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Grim Clicker is out of early access!
The game has been in Early Access longer than expected, but a lot of work has been done during that time. There are no major changes in this update. First of all, we want the game to come out of Early Access in a stable state. 

All the changes and content that was added during Early Access can be seen here, via Steam news.

As we think, these are the most important innovations made during Early Access:

Fixes:

notes.title: Version v.083d - Quickfix
notes.notes: Added the possibility to perform a ritual in the city.

notes.title: Huge Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Version v.083

In this update, you'll find many bugfixes, QoL improvements, and tweaks that the community has been asking for a long time.

New features:
 Added a new menu with detailed information on damage, crit multipliers, normal and magic crit chances. It can be accessed by clicking RMB on the damage icon. The menu makes stats more transparent and shows many of the stats that players previously had to calculate
 After many requests from players, we added automatic conversion of candles to wax at the end of the shards (in the towns), with the current exchange rate. Now this wax counts towards more flame power in the next shard. The exact number converted is shown by a new pop-up menu when entering a town


Major corrections:
 Lots of plant-related bugs have been fixed, in particular the 'Warm Radiance' skill scaling should now work normally for all plants (previously it only gave a bonus once every 10 levels or so). Typos and outdated descriptions have been fixed as well
 Wolf, General and Beetle transformation skills in their respective shards (Lunar, Clockwork, Luminous) are available earlier. Because of that, some other skills are available slightly earlier as well. Relevant information has been added to the shard descriptions
 More things are saved between game sessions! This update now includes saving and loading for all plant effects and all potion effects, as well as the 'March' skill. Previously they were reset after exiting the game. Where necessary, the descriptions have been changed a bit
 As a consequence, saving has been implemented for some related stats, such as % of poison on enemies or number of guaranteed crit hits, hero speed, and some others


Minor fixes:
  Fixed a bug where if player had a lot of skill icons it could cover the potions submenu
  Fixed that some weapon types were not getting the bonus from 'Rage of Darkness'
  Fixed incorrect bonus from 2nd syllable of Dragon on Heavy and Primal Heavy weapons
  Fixed that the 'Learn skill' soul action for General's gear skills didn't spend oil (now you can't abuse 'Ecology', for example).
  Fixed the 'Dark Balance' skill in the Spirit skill tree in a similar way
  Revised how bonus from taking any two syllables of 'P' sign work. Now when you take the bonus, General skill is no longer available on the level 9 of the player. Instead, the skill is moved to the stat 9 of Strength skill tree
  Also fixed the bug that this bonus worked only from 4 syllables taken (not 2, as in the description)
  Fixed a bug where with 'Mask of The Third Eye' you could take the General skill early for 1 SP (instead of 10 SP, as with all early unlocks)
  Fixed big Mana and Energy values not fitting into their respective vials
  Fixed incorrect description for Flame Flow when Flash skill and Rain syllables are taken. Added math for the fire stream amount to the description
  The 'Desecrate Shards' button now gives the correct amount of wax (previously it did not take into account bonuses from the shards shop).
  Fixed a rare bug where generation of new shard types could sometimes happen again if there were none left in current galaxy
  Minor fixes for Madness visuals
  Some fixes for weapon tooltip text
  Extended changelog of previous update
  And other rather minor fixes :)

notes.title: Game Update: New Shards
notes.notes:
Version v.082

Added 3 new shards.

Lunar Shard - the ritual does not reset the lunar bond (wolf).
Clockwork shard - the ritual does not reset the mechanics (general).
Luminous shard - the ritual does not reset the spirit (beetle).

In order for these new shards to appear in space, you must learn the corresponding syllables of the 'Wanderer' sign.

The 'Wanderer' sign is now fully completed, all syllables are available for study.

The syllables of the Candle reveal the capacity for fundamental knowledge, 
illuminating the way to the primal flame.

Some fixes:
 Flower bonuses are no longer kept when you leave theshard.
 The 'Blade Mastery' skill now has no effect on base repel of the shield.
 A small change in the sprint mechanics, designed to reduce the number of possible simultaneous clicks on a skill.
 Fixed an uncommon bug with shards and black holes flying away to the left.
 'Ecology' skill has been improved.

News from the Chaos Galaxy:
 Fixed a bug with appearance of branch mechanic in form of a wolf.
 Lunar Zvor gives +1 to Lunar bond if you have the right syllable when choosing to play as a wolf from space. Same with the General.

You can also read a brief description of the unlocked milestones.

notes.title: Version 069 - Mechanical General
notes.notes:
Version 069

Added character form: MECHANICAL GENERAL!
With the skill GENERAL you can transform into the Mechanical General. 

In this case, if you perform a ritual in the form of a General with a enought
amount of oil, after the ritual the character will remain a General.
The GENERAL skill is not necessary to maintain the form, it is necessary only for 
switching between the two appearances.

For the general, dexterity is replaced by mechanics.
The whole branch of dexterity has other skills and a different look.
General has no energy and cannot get tired.
General processes flowers and turns them into oil.

List of changes:
 Added new skill: GENERAL (strength)
 MONUMENTALITY has been moved from strength branch to the mechanics branch.
 Fixed sound of the cursed altar (when receiving a curse, the altar sounded like a fountain of beauty).
 Fixed an inaccuracy with the usurpation potion - now using the potion through the NUM0 button, like clicking on the potion with the mouse, creates living water in the presence of the necessary TAU syllable.
 Moon axes can now hit spiders.
 Fixed an error in the description of Panacea Seal in Russian.
 Clarified the description of the Dispel the Darkness skill.

notes.title: Version 062 - Forge of Souls, Space Tunnel, Transfer Area

In the transfer area itself monsters and bosses will be stronger, and the shards will have 60 and 70 zones!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/68e2f6c07d4524ec4118d451c25774cb7ce0c9be.png

notes.notes:

notes.title: Version 056 - Wisdom Branch
notes.notes:
The wisdom branch has been redone in this update. An item was also added that allows you to get stones from weapons. In addition, we managed to speed up the launch of the game (we upload the version with accelerated launch earlier than this announcement, so right now, probably, this change will be unnoticed).


 The game should start up faster (compared to previous versions)
 Added an item that allows you to extract stones from weapon
 Changes in the Wisdom branch: Wisdom gives +0.1 to mana regeneration (was +0.05)

 The Flash skill has been redesigned
 Added new skill: Diviner's Luck (allows Mana Lump to kill several monster in a row, adds a magic crit mechanics)
 Added new mask: Mask Of The Third Eye (allows you to see all the skills, you can open an inaccessible skill for 10 SP, gives 10 SP)

 Added hotkeys for 'safe' usurpation (0, Num0)

 Fixed several typos in the texts
 Added a few new names for galaxies
 Now you can open the singularity window without going into space

Version 053 Quest time counters now work offline
 Energy and mana now regenerate offline
 The game should start up faster from Steam
 Fixed issues with achievements (Rituals and Jeweler)
 Leveling a fire sword adds additional zones to the sword immediately
 Added safe use of returnable usurpation (right click)
 Added animation and sound for magical amplification
 Added 4 new bosses
 F12 takes a screenshot in Steam
 Fixed some bugs with sounds
 Fixed the bug with the ritual when sprint is used
 Fixed a bug with no bosses in the second galaxy
 Fixed bug with too long item names
 The scientific and engineering notation now works

notes.title: Game Update (Version 052)
notes.notes:
Version v.052

- Now you can view update information
- Added a message if the game was saved successfully
- Added warning on unsuccessful save (and instructions for solving the problem)
- Fixed bug with rubies in a rich chest
- Fixed a bug with the loss of the boss's chest (especially when exiting the menu)
- Added button to enable/disable weapon auto-upgrades
- Fixed a bug with bonfires in tutorial
- Fixed several bugs with sounds
- Fixed a bug with the knowledge window in the second galaxy
- Bloodshard now has special properties
- New music theme added

About the problem with saving backups for some players. As we have found out, saving a game can cause an error if non-Latin characters are used in the save path. We will try to deal with that problem, but for now a workaround is to save it to a folder with English name and to make sure that the save path contains only Latin characters.
